prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the loose facial sketch and mood basis, reinterpret the character as a polished full-body fantasy character design sheet: change the close-up rough head sketch into Stefan, an elegant young male knight standing in a calm three-quarter pose. Clean up the messy construction lines into refined anime-style line art, preserve only the delicate eye-focused beauty of the reference, and redesign the rest from scratch.

Additions and transformation: create exactly 1 full-body character, exactly 1 long sword held point-down in front of him, exactly 1 flowing blue translucent cape, and exactly 1 ornate white-and-navy knight outfit with silver armor accents. Give him long flowing silver-gray hair, a composed confident expression, and a slim princely silhouette. Outfit details should include layered white tunic panels, navy underclothes, belts, gloves, tall boots, shoulder armor, forearm armor, gold filigree trim, and star-like decorative clasps.

Style: convert the rough sketch into a clean, softly colored watercolor anime illustration with delicate pencil-like outlines, pale washes, subtle texture, and high-fantasy elegance. Use a light misty background with no scenery, no text, and no extra characters. Keep the composition centered on a vertical canvas, showing the entire figure from head to boots.

promptZh:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为面部和发型的基础，将粗糙的特写草图转换为 Stephan 的精致全身奇幻角色插画。将杂乱的构图线条清理为精炼的动漫线稿，将主体重新诠释为优雅的年轻男性骑士，并扩大画面以展示从头部到靴子的全身站立形象。

姿势与构图：创作 1 个角色，以平静的三分之二侧身姿势站立，面朝前方，带着从容的浅笑。保留参考图中精致的眼睛和飘逸的长发印象，但使设计更加优雅和完整。

新服装与道具：添加 1 套采用白色、海军蓝、银色和浅金色调的华丽骑士装：合身束腰外衣、多层腰带、手套、高筒靴、银色肩甲、护腕、装饰性扣环和刺绣饰边。添加 1 件在他身后飘动的半透明蓝色长披风。添加 1 把位于身体前方、带有装饰性金色细节的收鞘或下垂的剑。

风格：将草图转换为柔和的水彩奇幻角色设定图风格，要求线条纤细干净、色彩淡雅、具有细腻的纸张纹理、精致的少女漫比例以及明亮柔和的氛围。使用 白色、海军蓝、银色和浅金色。

背景：将空白的草图页面替换为极简的灰白色水彩渲染背景，带有极淡的蓝灰色薄雾和细小的柔和光点；无需风景、文字、边框或水印。
